title: Tofu Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir fry recipe with crispy tofu and a variety of colorful vegetables. Serve over rice or noodles for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, bell pepper, and broccoli to the skillet. Cook until the vegetables are tender-crisp, about 3-4 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and garlic powder. Pour the sauce over the vegetables and tofu.
Serve the stir fry hot over rice or noodles, garnished with green onions if desired.
